title: IntrinTrans: LLM-based Intrinsic Code Translator for RISC-V Vector
abstract: arXiv:2510.10119v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The use of intrinsic functions to leverage hardware-specific capabilities is a crucial approach for optimizing library performance. Many mainstream libraries implement a large number of vectorized algorithms on Arm or x86 SIMD (Single-Instruction, Multiple-Data) intrinsic functions. Translating existing vectorized intrinsic code into the intrinsics of an emerging architecture is a practical and effective approach. However, current cross-architecture translation largely relies on manual rewriting or rule-based mapping methods, which are both time-consuming and prone to errors. We present \texttt{IntrinTrans}, a LLM-based agent that utilizes compile-and-test feedback to translate intrinsic code across architectures automatically, and further optimizes the generated intrinsics using register-usage information derived from liveness analysis. translated_title: IntrinTrans：基于大语言模型的RISC-V向量内在函数翻译器
translated_abstract: 摘要：使用内在函数来利用硬件特定能力是优化库性能的关键方法。许多主流库在Arm或x86 SIMD（单指令多数据）内在函数上实现了大量向量化算法。将现有的向量化内在代码翻译成新兴架构的内在函数是一种实用且有效的方法。然而，当前的跨架构翻译主要依赖于手动重写或基于规则的映射方法，这些方法既耗时又容易出错。我们提出了IntrinTrans，一个基于大语言模型的智能体，它利用编译和测试反馈自动跨架构翻译内在代码，并进一步使用基于活跃性分析得到的寄存器使用信息来优化生成的内在函数。为了评估我们方法的有效性，我们使用IntrinTrans翻译了开源的代码。
tldr: IntrinTrans是一个基于大语言模型的智能体，通过编译测试反馈和活跃性分析自动翻译并优化跨架构内在代码，显著减少手动工作并提高准确性。
en_tdlr: IntrinTrans is an LLM-based agent that automatically translates and optimizes cross-architecture intrinsic code using compile-test feedback and liveness analysis, significantly reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
